title: Great Plains Crisis Network 988 Center
summary: A fictional Nebraska nonprofit that runs the state's 988 Lifeline center (74 staff, about 750 contacts a day) and an exercise generated from its simulated plans: a community tragedy in a small fictional town drives call, text and chat volume to more than double, and the center must activate its surge plan, request backup in time, speak safely in public and look after its own counselors.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Great Plains Crisis Network, its people, systems and the town and tragedy in the scenario are simulated; no real person is involved and no method detail is described. The public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/crisis-center-988/SOURCES.md. This exercise includes difficult material; anyone may step out at any time.

scenarios.title: Two Intervals Behind
scenarios.summary: On a Thursday afternoon in March a fictional school bus and truck crash near the small town of Ellery Ridge, Nebraska, kills several students; over the next hours calls, texts and chats to GPCN more than double, the queues pass the plan's thresholds, and the center must surge, request backup, communicate safely and protect its counselors.
